sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r12/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (sha256 6d44970b...fd7f; read in memory with openpyxl read_only) sheet 'Quality Checks' row 22 (#21) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 22 (#21, no annotation column text); 'Deterministic Checks' rows 33 check-scoring-policy.py and 36 check-verifier-contract.py for context; no comment parts in the xlsx zip
evidence: Static review against the staged-task-contract test.sh order. task/tests/test.sh (sha256 bd682592...e5aa), tests/tools/score.py (13de2b38...e04e), tests/tools/restart_mcp.py and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty), so the entrypoint is template-controlled and was not altered. (1) Zero reward first: write_zero_reward at test.sh:60 writes reward.txt 0.0, a reward.json with reward, all five dimensions, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op (ZERO_REWARD_JSON test.sh:8), and ctrf.json; trap cleanup EXIT at :61 calls ensure_reward (:20-23, :39). No exec anywhere. (2) Exit paths walked: missing REWARDKIT env (:63-66), missing /app/server.js (:68-70), symlink outside /app/node_modules or node_modules link resolving outside it (:72-83), liveness failure after 120x0.25s (:115-125), app_context substitution failure (set -e, trap), gates rewardkit failure/timeout (:213-215), score.py exit 1 keeps detailed gate-fail record with reward 0 (:220; score.py:48,83), score.py exit 2 -> write_zero_reward (:221; score.py:86-91 catches all exceptions), scored rewardkit failure/timeout (:224-226; reward stays the post-gates score.py value, which is 0 because scored_ran is false, score.py:42-48), final score.py failure -> write_zero_reward (:227). Every path leaves a reward.txt/reward.json. Stale scored output removed before gates (:212). (3) Safe launch: copies /app aside (:90-95), launches with setsid env -i carrying only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH and setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups (:104-111); LOG_DIR chmod 700 (:11) and /tests go-rwx (:12) so the unprivileged app cannot overwrite reward files; cleanup kills the process group via app.pid, including a restarted one (:25-37). util-linux (setpriv) and procps are installed in tests/Dockerfile:13. (4) Liveness before RewardKit: probe_ready on /api/health then / (:42-58) gates entry to the restart-helper and suites. (5) Order: gates suite (budget 1500) -> score.py -> scored suite (budget 11100) -> score.py (:212-227). Budget nesting: gate judges 600+600=1200<1500 run sequentially (--max-concurrent-agent 1); scored 9000+900+900=10800<11100; 1500+11100+30s startup < [verifier].timeout_sec 13200 (task.toml:27). Restart helper generated by heredoc+sed, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (:127-193). Counterexample attempts: (a) broken app that answers HTTP 500 on every route passes liveness because HTTPError counts as ready (:51-52) - by design liveness only; the render/constraints gates and score.py gate logic then zero it, so the row is not defeated. (b) conforming alternative binding only localhost/::1 would fail the 127.0.0.1 probe, but integration.md:5-6 publicly requires 0.0.0.0, and the golden binds 0.0.0.0 (solution/app/src/bootstrap.js:43); a slow but conforming app beyond 30s would still be scored 0 rather than left unscored, and integration.md:9-10 asks health to answer before DB work (any brief-level timing gap belongs to row 23). Latent P3 only: if mkdir/chmod of LOG_DIR at :10-11 failed, set -e would exit before write_zero_reward, but then no reward could be written anyway; and an outer SIGKILL mid score.py write could truncate a file - template-controlled, not task defects. Risk is true solely for missing measurement: raw-evidence-index.json scope states full configured grading is absent; its 25-group scripted run (workspace.json sha256 7ae5b5c3...3241, verified matching) ran the golden as uid 65534 in the verifier image with a restart, but did not execute test.sh, so its exit paths, launch and reward writing are not exercised on this candidate. No Docker run was started by this reviewer.
